Class PlayerScoringDeltaDto

java.lang.Object
shared.dto.event.PlayerScoringDeltaDto
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerScoringDeltaDto extends Object implements Serializable
Breakdown of the five end-game scoring sources for a single player. The details string is server-formatted ready to display.
